messages:
jordan_customer: Hey — noticed a weird billing/credits mismatch for org_acme_123. Dashboard (Usage > Promo credits) shows 2,400 promo credits remaining, but invoice inv_00AXY finalized yesterday consumed promo credits and left a post-invoice promo_remaining: 0. No subscription change on our side. Can someone take a look?

elaine_support: Thanks Jordan — can you paste the org id + invoice id and a sample request id from the window? Also were those mostly completions or embeddings?

jordan_customer: org_id: org_acme_123, invoice: inv_00AXY, invoice_ts: 2064827000. Mostly completions, a couple small embeddings. Sample request id: req_abc123. Dashboard snapshot time (top-right) showed promo snapshot 2064825000 reporting 2400.

kevin_billing: pulling ledger now. Quick note: our invoice finalizer applies credit buckets in a specific order (reserved -> expiring promos -> non-expiring promos). We recently changed ordering for backfills. Are you expecting FIFO? @mira_engineer can you check token-metering vs invoice aggregator for req_abc123?

mira_engineer: Looking at req_abc123. Token-meter shows total_tokens: 25000, promo_deduct: 25000, free_pool_used: 0, post_invoice_balance: 0. Dashboard cache snapshot and ledger state may have diverged due to a backfill job. Can you run the usage API for that time window and paste the raw? Example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?org=org_acme_123&start=2064824000&end=2064828000"
```

jordan_customer: ran the call, got: `{\n  "org": "org_acme_123",\n  "total_tokens": 25120,\n  "promo_applied": 25000,\n  "promo_remaining": 0,\n  "last_snapshot_ts": 2064825000\n}`. But UI still shows 2400. Promo metadata in dashboard shows promoA (id promo_A_77) expiring 2065000000.

kevin_billing: OK I can see an invoice finalizer job at 2064827200 that consumed credits. There's also a backfill ledger mutation (rollback/reapply) for a previous promo (promo_B_02) at 2064827100 that reallocated 2400 credits between internal buckets. Looks like the backfill and finalizer ran concurrently and finalizer consumed the credits after the reallocation, leaving the UI cache stale. This is a race between backfill + invoice finalization.

elaine_support: TL;DR repro: 1) Customer had two promos (promoB older, promoA newer). 2) Ops ran a backfill/rollback on promoB to fix an earlier misallocation (this created a backdated ledger mutation). 3) Invoice finalizer ran and, because the ledger snapshot occurred after the backfill, it applied credits from the adjusted bucket and zeroed out the promoA balance in the finalized invoice. Dashboard cache still had the old snapshot until UI cache refresh.

mira_engineer: Proposed immediate mitigation: restore the original ledger state for those 2400 credits and issue an invoice adjustment credit (adj_INV_204) to reverse the unexpected consumption. Longer term: change invoice finalizer to take an atomic snapshot before applying backfills, and/or reorder backfill jobs to avoid running during invoice finalization windows. Filing a bug.

kevin_billing: Filed BL-789 to track. I'm issuing a manual credit of 2,400 promo tokens to org_acme_123 now and generating an invoice adjustment adj_INV_204. Jordan — will that be OK while we root-cause?

jordan_customer: That would help, thanks. Also can we get a note or banner in the UI about possible 5-10 minute lag after invoice finalization/backfills? We rely on live promo counts for throttling customer flows.

ops-bot: Incident BL-789 created by kevin_billing. Priority: high. Assigned: mira_engineer, elaine_support.

mira_engineer: Temporary fix applied: created ledger credit tx_restore_7745 and invoice adj_INV_204. Verified usage API now returns `promo_remaining: 2400` and ledger shows tx_restore_7745. Waiting for billing-cache TTL to expire (<10m) for UI to reflect change.

jordan_customer: Confirmed UI updated — promo shows 2,400 again. Thanks for the quick turnaround :heart: :raised_hands:

elaine_support: Closing once billing confirms final reconciliation on next run. Follow-up items: add audit-log link for promo ledger mutations in dashboard, and push a patch to invoice finalizer to snapshot prior to backfills.

kevin_billing: Notes for internal triage: BL-789 -> root cause: concurrent backfill + invoice finalizer ordering. Impact: visible promo mismatch for small number of orgs, possible transient negative post-invoice promo_remaining in API. Fix: atomic snapshot + backfill scheduling.

mira_engineer: I'll pair with infra on a small change: invoice-finalizer will now create a read-only snapshot key `invoice_snapshot_ts` before accepting any ledger mutations for the same invoice window. Rolling this to prod tomorrow off-hours.

jordan_customer: Appreciate the detail & fix. Will open a support ticket if anything pops up during our next billing cycle.

elaine_support: Marking thread resolved for now. If anything else appears please reopen. :thumbsup:
